title.narrative: Support to the Inclusive National Dialogue in Mozambique

description.narrative: This Project Initiation Plan (PIP) is formulated to translate UNDP’s offer in response to above request and sets out the framework to address urgent needs and for the immediate implementation required to support the Inclusive National Dialogue in Mozambique. This PIP is expected to evolve into a full-fledged Project Document on “Support to the Inclusive National Dialogue in Mozambique”, covering both the dialogue phase and the transition to implementation from 2026. These needs will be met through the document and other ongoing UNDP initiatives, contributions from the UN Country Office, and support from other UN entities and international partners, while the full Project Document is being developed in parallel. Furthermore, the document will establish a mechanism to receive contributions from international partners interested in supporting the Inclusive National dialogue.
